articles.title: NASA Awards Contract for NOAA’s Near Earth Orbit Network Program
articles.snippet: NASA, on behalf of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), has awarded a contract to Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation for the Sounder for Microwave-Based Applications (SMBA) instruments on NOAA’s Near Earth Orbit Network (NEON) satellites. articles.title: Studying Cancer Cells in Microgravity
articles.snippet: This Nov. 19, 2026, image shows gastric microtumors grown within an Encapsulates biochip. The Encapsulate-1 investigation studies patient-derived tumor samples aboard the International Space Station to better understand how cancer cells move and interact in microgravity. The results could help researchers develop further testing to predict a patient's risk of metastasis and support more...

articles.title: NASA Seeks Partners to Design First Nuclear Reactor for the Moon
articles.snippet: NASA is seeking industry partners to develop and test the first nuclear reactor designed to provide electricity on the Moon, a major step toward establishing a sustained human presence on the lunar surface. articles.title: NASA’s Webb Shows How Supernova Dust Chronicles Star Evolution
articles.snippet: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has painted a vibrant tapestry of the legendary supernova remnant Cassiopeia A (Cas A). Remnants like these are the clouds of gas and dust that remain following the explosion of a massive star and will eventually seed a new generation of stars and planets.
